description: Tell the person how your run is going. They watch it live in Buoy Desktop. Send one when a sim starts work, passes, fails or needs help, with a short note. `counts` only when you know the full task list. Reports never add time. Pass an increasing `sequence` so a retry is never counted twice.

note.description: Short and plain, e.g. 'Idea 3: 58 fps, best so far'.

resultSource.description: 'test' when a test runner decided pass or fail, 'agent' when you judged it. Default agent.

udid.description: The sim this is about. Leave out for the whole run.

name: sim_farm_report
